description:
Advances: ancora.derive
Ready-for: investigate
Severity: High (calibrated; pre-existing, exposed by the 2026-09-05 critical review audit of ancora-gg8.9).

Symptom: a lib file containing defmodule Outer do defmodule __MODULE__.Inner do def value, do: :ok end end makes Ancora.Derive.DefIndex raise (literal_segments admits the __MODULE__ tuple and add_definition joins it, Protocol.UndefinedError).
Evidence: before ancora-gg8.9 this crashed mix spec.check with a raw EXIT; since gg8.9 the def_index worker rescue turns it into an env-tier verdict, and the spec_check_test "a nested __MODULE__ name emits a def_index environment verdict" depends on this shape raising (comment at that test).
Why now: valid Elixir fails the gate at the environment tier. Fix DefIndex to resolve __MODULE__ in nested module names (or skip such definitions deterministically), then replace that test fixture with another worker-raising shape.
title: DefIndex crashes on defmodule __MODULE__.Inner (valid nested module name)
